prompt: Quick audit — what are the worst code quality issues and performance problems in the codebase? Things like any types, missing school_id filters, or N+1 queries.

assertions.text: Report checks for TypeScript 'any' types and either finds instances with file paths or confirms none exist
Report checks for ilike queries missing escapeIlikePattern() — either finding specific instances or confirming all are protected
Report addresses N+1 query patterns or over-fetching (e.g., select(*) without pagination on large tables)
Report mentions the procurements schema mismatch risk (lib/supabase/server.ts uses public schema, not procurements)
Report includes at least 5 specific file paths or line number references
Report distinguishes between code quality issues and performance issues (separate sections or clear labeling)
